note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified; the only difference between A and B is the supplied route, statuses are shown as supplied, and no ranking, winner or outcome is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional guest-pass rule with two alternative routes. Scenario A sends the supplied fact by Route A (a member's written invitation), scenario B by Route B (a partner-club card). Both capsules push the shuttle ball to opposite seats and land in the same tray.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional library-fee rule. Scenario A sends by Route A (night-slot log, supplied); scenario B sends by Route B, whose fact is supplied as DISPUTED — B's capsule is stopped at its check gate with a question disc and never reaches the valve, so B's tray stays empty. Nothing is decided about the dispute.

rules.name: Library rule 9 (fictional text): a late fee may be looked at again by either route
conditions: The book was returned through the night slot
A staff member recorded a desk extension

facts.label: Night-slot log shows the book at 23:10 on Day 14
Desk note about an extension, signature unclear

assumptions: Hypothetical fee; no amount is decided here

scenarioB.label: Route B
scenarioB.caption: desk note sent, supplied as disputed

params.changedFact: the fact travels as the night-slot log (A) or as the disputed desk note (B)
sharedFacts: Same book, same borrower, same fee notice

comparisonLabels.neutral: B is stopped at its gate as supplied — nothing about the dispute is decided

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names and texts near the field limits: long rule caption, conditions, facts, scenario labels, changed fact, shared facts, neutral note, assumptions and issue. Text wraps between words; sizes stay at or above 16 px at 1080p.

rules.name: Rule M-27 (fictional housing co-operative rule): a request to use the shared roof terrace may arrive by either route
conditions: The request is countersigned by two registered members of the housing co-operative board
The requester presents the stamped annual terrace permit issued by the caretaker's office

facts.label: Request form countersigned by Maria-Fernanda Castellanos and Oluwaseun Adeyemi-Clarke
Terrace permit no. T-5561 stamped by the caretaker's office, shown on Day 13

issues: Were both countersignatures added before the request was placed in the tube? (not examined here)
assumptions: Each route is read on its own and neither route is ranked above the other
The dates are taken from the documents as supplied; none of them is verified here

scenarioA.label: Route A · countersigned request
scenarioA.caption: the countersigned request form goes in at inlet A

scenarioB.label: Route B · stamped terrace permit
scenarioB.caption: a copy of the stamped terrace permit goes in at inlet B

params.changedFact: the supplied document travels as the countersigned request form (A) or as the stamped annual terrace permit copy (B)
sharedFacts: Same requester, same terrace, same weekend booking
Same rule M-27 and the same co-operative office tray

comparisonLabels.guide: Only the route of the supplied document differs
comparisonLabels.neutral: Both reach the same point of analysis by different routes; neither route is ranked and no outcome is shown
